sport.description: Optional sport the list is about, for filtering polls.

league.description: Optional league code, e.g. cfb, for merging rankings.

curated.description: A list made for others, e.g. 'Big Ten football'.

ranking.description: An ordered list, e.g. 'My top 25'. Items carry position; viewers can merge many fans' rankings into one poll.

favorites.description: The owner's own teams, people or events to follow; viewers show these first.

description: A list of teams, people or events, kept in the owner's own repo, e.g. 'My teams'. Items are separate listitem records.
